purpose: Turn token creation into guided economic design while preserving Worldz Safe Launch, Fee Flow V3, chain-native execution and proof requirements.

researchPrinciples.demandBeforeScarcity: A token needs a reason to be acquired, used or held; scarcity alone is not treated as value.
researchPrinciples.activityLinkedEconomics: Prefer economics where real product/network activity funds liquidity, security, treasury or verifiable buyback/burn lanes.
researchPrinciples.transparentFloat: Show real circulating float and unlock schedules at launch, day 30, day 90, year 1 and year 2.
researchPrinciples.dilutionDisclosure: Never hide future unlocks behind headline market cap or low initial float.
researchPrinciples.liquidityMatters: Liquidity depth, LP protection and sell-path proof are part of token design.
researchPrinciples.communityDistribution: Prefer broad disclosed distribution over hidden insider concentration.
researchPrinciples.utilityIsSpecific: Utility must name an actual function such as fees, access, staking/security, settlement, collateral, rewards or product use.
researchPrinciples.noGuaranteedValue: Worldz does not promise price appreciation, yield, returns or a top-token outcome.
researchPrinciples.proofOverClaims: Every supply, lock, vesting, treasury and burn statement must be backed by WorldzProof/on-chain evidence when executed.

worldzCard.preferredFlow: user-approved asset -> compliant conversion/settlement asset -> licensed card/payment partner -> ordinary merchant acceptance

KYC/AML and sanctions controls where required
